headline: Bitcoin Nears $81,000 Ahead of US Federal Reserve Interest Rate Decision
summary: Bitcoin approached $81,000 as tech stocks extended gains and broader crypto majors advanced, with markets awaiting a key policy decision from the Federal Reserve.
why: Bitcoin is the largest cryptocurrency by market capitalization and frequently trades as a high-beta proxy for broader liquidity expectations and risk appetite.

impacts.name: Bitcoin
impacts.why: Crypto token valuations are rising alongside a rally in technology shares ahead of major central bank monetary policy updates.

why_moved: Cryptocurrency assets rallied as optimism across technology equities spilled over into digital assets ahead of central bank rate deliberations.
